example: She whispered something in his ear.
example_ru: Она что-то прошептала ему на ухо.

def: to talk in a friendly way about small things
example: We chatted for an hour on the phone.
example_ru: Мы болтали по телефону целый час.

def: to answer a question, letter or message
example: She didn't reply to my email.
example_ru: Она не ответила на моё письмо.

def: to say something about a thing in a few words
example: He mentioned that he was moving to London.
example_ru: Он упомянул, что переезжает в Лондон.
note_ru: Don't mention it! — Не за что!

def: to have a meaning; to want to say
example: What does this word mean?
note_ru: I mean... — я имею в виду...

def: to suddenly understand something
example: I realised that I had left my keys at home.
example_ru: Я понял, что оставил ключи дома.
note_ru: Ложный друг: не «реализовать». В США — realize.

def: to choose what to do after thinking
example: We decided to stay at home.

def: to think that something will happen
example: I expect it will rain tomorrow.
note_ru: «Ждать» на остановке — wait, а не expect.

def: to ask yourself about something
example: I wonder where she is.
note_ru: I was wondering if... — вежливая просьба.

def: to know someone or something because you saw them before
example: I didn't recognise you with short hair!
example_ru: Я тебя не узнал с короткими волосами!

def: to see or hear something
example: Did you notice her new glasses?

def: to make a picture of something in your mind
example: Imagine you are on a beach.

def: to help someone remember something
example: Remind me to buy milk.
note_ru: remind somebody to do; remind somebody of — напоминать (быть похожим).

def: to say sorry
example: He apologised for being late.

def: to give an answer when you are not sure
example: Guess how old I am!

def: to get out of bed in the morning
example: I get up at seven every day.
example_ru: Я встаю в семь каждый день.

def: to stop sleeping
example: I woke up at six because of the noise.
example_ru: Я проснулся в шесть из-за шума.
note_ru: wake up — проснуться, get up — встать с кровати.

def: to try to find something
example: I'm looking for my keys.

def: to take care of someone or something
example: Who looks after the children when you work?
example_ru: Кто присматривает за детьми, когда ты работаешь?

def: to feel happy because something nice is going to happen
example: I'm looking forward to the weekend.
note_ru: После to — существительное или -ing: look forward to seeing you.

def: to make a light, TV or machine start working
example: Turn on the light, please.

def: to make a light, TV or machine stop working
example: Don't forget to turn off the TV.

def: to make the sound or heat stronger
example: Turn up the music — I love this song!
example_ru: Сделай музыку погромче — обожаю эту песню!
note_ru: Также «появиться, прийти»: He turned up late.

def: to make the sound or heat weaker
example: Can you turn down the TV? I'm studying.
example_ru: Можешь сделать телевизор потише? Я занимаюсь.

def: to start wearing clothes
example: Put on your coat — it's cold outside.

def: to stop wearing clothes; (plane) to leave the ground
example: Take off your shoes in the house.
note_ru: The plane takes off at 9 — самолёт взлетает в 9.

def: to put on clothes to see if they fit
example: Can I try on these jeans?

def: to stop doing something; to stop trying
example: He gave up smoking last year.
example_ru: В прошлом году он бросил курить.

def: to take something from the floor; to collect someone in a car
example: I'll pick you up at the station.

def: to go onto a bus, train or plane
example: We got on the bus at the market.
example_ru: Мы сели в автобус у рынка.
note_ru: В машину — get in / get out of.

def: to leave a bus, train or plane
example: Get off at the next stop.

def: to continue; to happen
example: Go on — I'm listening.

def: to return to a place
example: When are you coming back from Spain?

def: to get information about something
example: I'll find out what time the shop opens.
example_ru: Я узнаю, во сколько открывается магазин.

def: to write information on a form
example: Please fill in this form.

def: to change from a child into an adult
example: I grew up in a small village.

def: to start a journey
example: We set off early in the morning.
example_ru: Мы отправились в путь рано утром.

def: to put something in the rubbish
example: Throw away those old newspapers.

def: to have no more of something
example: We've run out of milk.

def: to continue doing something
example: Carry on working — I'll come back later.

def: nice to sit, lie or be in
example: This sofa is very comfortable.

def: new and of the present time
example: They live in a modern flat.

def: done in the same way for a long time
example: We ate traditional Russian food.

def: happening most of the time
example: I'll meet you at the usual place.

def: not usual; better or more important than others
example: Today is a special day — it's our anniversary.
example_ru: Сегодня особенный день — у нас годовщина.

def: unusual and surprising
example: I heard a strange noise in the night.

def: very bad
example: The weather was terrible all week.

def: very good; making you happy
example: We had a wonderful holiday in Greece.
example_ru: У нас был чудесный отпуск в Греции.

def: very surprising and very good
example: The view from the top was amazing.

def: very bad
example: The food in that café was awful.
example_ru: Еда в том кафе была отвратительная.

def: very very good
example: Her English is excellent.

def: with nothing wrong; the best possible
example: It's a perfect day for a picnic.

def: liked by many people
example: Football is the most popular sport in the world.
example_ru: Футбол — самый популярный вид спорта в мире.

def: almost the same
example: Your bag is similar to mine.

def: not wide
example: The streets in the old town are very narrow.
example_ru: Улицы в старом городе очень узкие.

def: a long way from one side to the other
example: The river is very wide here.

def: going a long way down
example: Be careful, the water is deep.

def: very very big
example: They have a huge dog.

def: very very small
example: The baby has tiny hands.

def: a little, but not very
example: The film was quite good.

def: almost sure, but not 100%
example: It will probably rain tomorrow.

def: more than others
example: I love fruit, especially strawberries.

def: quickly and without warning
example: Suddenly the lights went out.

def: used to say that something is sad or bad
example: Unfortunately, the tickets are sold out.

def: used to say that something good happened
example: Luckily, nobody was hurt.

def: used to say that something is surprising after the first part
example: Although it was cold, we went swimming.
example_ru: Хотя было холодно, мы пошли купаться.

def: but; used to start a new sentence
example: The hotel was nice. However, it was very expensive.
example_ru: Отель был хороший. Однако он был очень дорогой.

def: during the time that something happens
example: I read a book while I was waiting.

def: up to the time when
example: Wait here until I come back.
example_ru: Подожди здесь, пока я не вернусь.

def: immediately after something happens
example: Call me as soon as you arrive.
note_ru: После as soon as — настоящее время, не will.

def: from a time in the past until now
example: I've lived here since 2015.
note_ru: since + момент (since Monday), for + период (for two years).

def: until now (in questions and negative sentences)
example: Have you finished yet? — No, not yet.
example_ru: Ты уже закончил? — Нет, ещё нет.

def: before now or before this time
example: I've already seen this film.

def: continuing until now
example: Are you still working here?

def: in the beginning
example: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
example_ru: Поначалу город мне не нравился, но теперь я его люблю.

def: after a long time; as the last thing
example: Finally, the bus arrived.
note_ru: Для списка действий: first, then, finally.

def: after everything; as the result
example: In the end, we decided to stay at home.
example_ru: В итоге мы решили остаться дома.
note_ru: at the end of — в конце чего-то (фильма, улицы).

def: now
example: I'm busy at the moment — can I call you later?
example_ru: Я сейчас занят — можно я перезвоню позже?

def: at the present time, not in the past
example: Nowadays most people have a smartphone.
example_ru: В наши дни у большинства людей есть смартфон.

def: one time; at a time in the past
example: I go to the gym once a week.
example_ru: Я хожу в спортзал раз в неделю.
note_ru: once a week, twice a week, three times a week.

def: two times
example: I've been to London twice.

def: now, without waiting
example: Come here immediately!

def: later, after something else
example: We had dinner and afterwards we watched a film.
example_ru: Мы поужинали, а потом посмотрели фильм.

def: in the time of something
example: Please don't talk during the film.
example_ru: Пожалуйста, не разговаривайте во время фильма.

def: the two together
example: Both my brothers live in Moscow.
example_ru: Оба моих брата живут в Москве.

def: one or the other of two
example: You can take either bus — they both go to the centre.
example_ru: Можешь сесть на любой автобус — оба идут в центр.
note_ru: either ... or ... — или ..., или ...; I don't like it either — мне тоже не нравится.

def: used to change the subject or say something is not important
example: It was raining, but we went out anyway.
example_ru: Шёл дождь, но мы всё равно пошли гулять.

def: used to say something new that you have just remembered
example: By the way, did you phone your mum?

def: really; in fact
example: Actually, I don't like coffee very much.
example_ru: Вообще-то, я не очень люблю кофе.

def: in the place of something
example: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
example_ru: Давай пойдём пешком вместо того, чтобы ехать на автобусе.
note_ru: instead of + -ing; просто instead — в конце предложения.
